item.tib: de kho na nyid kyi snying po sgrub pa zhes bya ba
item.skt: tat+t+wa gar+b+ha sA d+ha naM nA Ma
item.coloph: byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la gnas pa'i phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor gyi bde mchog gyi bsgrub pa/ de kho na nyid kyi snying po zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po so ma nA thas/ /gnyal mi shes rab mchog gi don du bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab pa'o
